Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates a complete white-out of the left hemithorax with a distinct mediastinal shift to the right (away from the affected side). In the context of pyo-pneumothorax, this indicates a massive pleural collection (pus and air) exerting positive pressure that pushes the mediastinum contralaterally, distinguishing it from atelectasis which would pull the mediastinum ipsilaterally.
